messages.subject: [R-marketing-bugs] Welcome to R Marketing Bugs
messages.body_plain:
This message is a test that the bug system is working for Chapman & Feit
(2015), R for Marketing Research and Analytics.

This space on R Forge is for tracking errata and code bugs for the R code
in the book.

If you think you've found a bug:
* To check out general errata and help:
http://r-marketing.r-forge.r-project.org/errata.html
* To view archives of previous bug reports:
http://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/pipermail/r-marketing-bugs/
* To report a new bug, please send email to:
r-marketing-bugs at lists.r-forge.r-project.org

-- Chris Chapman
